description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for managing transfer history records in a local database. It includes methods for observing, fetching, inserting, updating, and deleting transfer history data, specifically for use with Room persistence library in Android.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Observes all transfer history records ordered by start time descending.

methods.name: getByConnectionId
methods.description: Observes transfer history for a specific connection, ordered by start time descending.

methods.name: getRecent
methods.description: Provides a stream of recent transfers limited by the given count.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a transfer history record.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a transfer record by entity.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a transfer record by id.

calls: androidx.room.Query("SELECT * FROM transfer_history ORDER BY startedAtMillis DESC")
androidx.room.Query("SELECT * FROM transfer_history WHERE connectionId = :connectionId ORDER BY startedAtMillis DESC")
androidx.room.Query("SELECT * FROM transfer_history ORDER BY startedAtMillis DESC LIMIT :limit")
